title: feature request - Improve priming process of Dana pumps for blind people!
symptom: Blind users cannot see the Dana pump display, making priming and tube filling difficult, especially if the autosetter is damaged. The user requests the ability to insert priming data via AAPS instead of on the pump.
cause: The Dana pump does not support the functionality to set priming data remotely; AAPS cannot do it directly and would only fake it by doing a bolus.
fix: No fix or workaround is provided; the maintainer states that the Dana pump does not support this functionality and that doing it in AAPS would be faked by doing a bolus.
evidence_quote: Dana pump doesn't support this functionality
